## Batch 64

Authored four draft items, both PA-33 pages, the manifest, coverage, proof contracts, notes, and cross-batch dependency input. The batch-32 page prerequisite remains open because its page and items are still drafts.

All scoped checks passed: proof layout (4 items, 11 steps, 0 defects), rendering (6 files), content policy, focused dependency check, strict proof contracts, source-fetch verification (4/4), and batch-local dependency levels.

I also replaced the rank-one Hecke example’s complement argument with a direct proof that the dual-number regular module is not semisimple.

## Owner handoff

The PA-33 design is reuse-focused, while PA-34 explicitly proposes spectral R-matrix work. The three spectral items are complete as finite-dimensional proofs, but their canonical placement needs owner reconciliation. The notes document the conflict and proposed resolution.

All four `step1-decisions record` attempts failed before writing: `loadStep3` stops at duplicate item `lem-it-quantum-relative-entropy-support-regularization` in batch 21 and batch 22. The same manifests also duplicate `lem-it-quantum-relative-entropy-isometric-invariance` and `thm-it-holevo-measurement-bound`. No readiness records were written; the native run status reports this duplicate as the `1-scaffold` blocker.
